Temporal Sage Chronos says we need to be cautious, but how can I be cautious when my whole world is turning upside down? The Great War of Shadows begins means nothing will ever be the same.

I'm scared. I'm excited. I'm terrified that we're not ready for what's coming. Creative but temperamental - that's what everyone says about me. Maybe they're right...

Author: Druid Oakenheart
Date: Year 1230, Private Journal

Today changed everything. I can't stop thinking about what we found in The Eternal Citadel. The Chronos Hourglass - it's not just a relic, it's alive somehow. I felt it reaching out, almost like it recognized me.

The Voice in Darkness says we need to be cautious, but how can I be cautious when my whole world is turning upside down? The The Great Summit - all factions meet means nothing will ever be the same.

I'm scared. I'm excited. I'm terrified that we're not ready for what's coming. Patient and strong - that's what everyone says about me. Maybe they're right...

Author: Archmage Lysander
Date: Year 1233, Private Journal

Today changed everything. I can't stop thinking about what we found in Harmonic Nexus. The The World Engine - it's not just a relic, it's alive somehow. I felt it reaching out, almost like it recognized me.

Chronicler Aria the Keeper says we need to be cautious, but how can I be cautious when my whole world is turning upside down? The Final confrontation at Harmonic Nexus means nothing will ever be the same.

I'm scared. I'm excited. I'm terrified that we're not ready for what's coming. Visionary but arrogant - that's what everyone says about me. Maybe they're right...

Author: Scholar Theron
Date: Year 1245, Private Journal

Today changed everything. I can't stop thinking about what we found in Starfall Valley. The The World Engine - it's not just a relic, it's alive somehow. I felt it reaching out, almost like it recognized me.

The Phantom (identity unknown) says we need to be cautious, but how can I be cautious when my whole world is turning upside down? The Great War of Shadows begins means nothing will ever be the same.

Herein recorded for posteritie, Anno Domini 1231

Be it known unto all who shall read these wordes, that in the Year of Our Reckoning 1231, there occurred most wondrous and terrible events at the place men call Aethermoor City.

The esteemed Commander Gearhart, being Steam Knight General of The Shadow Council, did discover ye The Convergence Core, an relique of the Ancients bearing great and terrible power. The manner of its discovery was thus:

Upon the dawning of the seventh day, as the twin suns did rise over the eastern mountains, a great light did shine forth from the earth. Those present did witness the awakening of forces long dormant, and were sore afraid...

metadata.faction: The Shadow Council

text:
<|report|>
Author: The Wanderer
Date: Year 1255, Private Journal

Today changed everything. I can't stop thinking about what we found in Aethermoor City. The Storm Crown - it's not just a relic, it's alive somehow. I felt it reaching out, almost like it recognized me.

Elder Willow the Ancient says we need to be cautious, but how can I be cautious when my whole world is turning upside down? The Shadow Council reveals existence through ultimatum means nothing will ever be the same.

I'm scared. I'm excited. I'm terrified that we're not ready for what's coming. All-knowing but cryptic - that's what everyone says about me. Maybe they're right...

metadata.event: Shadow Council reveals existence through ultimatum

Elder Willow the Ancient says we need to be cautious, but how can I be cautious when my whole world is turning upside down? The First Sky Pirate raids begin means nothing will ever be the same.
